display.purpose: Page titles. Appears exactly once per page.

title.purpose: Card headings, sidebar app name, subsection titles.

label.purpose: Metadata, stat card labels, nav items.

motion.name: state-transition
motion.purpose: Default state transition for interactive elements.

components.name: Sidebar Nav Item
components.description: Navigation link in the dashboard sidebar. Active state uses Pine + Moss Tint.
components.css: .ds-nav-item { display: flex; align-items: center; padding: 8px 12px; border-radius: 6px; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; color: #6b7280; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 0.15s ease, color 0.15s ease; } .ds-nav-item:hover { background-color: #f9fafb; color: #1f2937; } .ds-nav-item-active { background-color: #eaf0e6; color: #007943; } .ds-nav-item-active:hover { background-color: #eaf0e6; color: #007943; }

components.name: Stat Card
components.description: Metric display card on the dashboard overview.
components.css: .ds-stat-card { background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #e5e7eb; border-radius: 8px; padding: 20px 24px; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; } .ds-stat-card-label { margin: 0 0 4px 0; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; color: #6b7280; letter-spacing: 0.025em; } .ds-stat-card-value { margin: 0; font-size: clamp(1.5rem, 4vw, 2rem); font-weight: 700; color: #1f2937; line-height: 1.2; }

components.name: Error Banner
components.html: Failed to load stations. Please try again.
components.css: .ds-error-banner { background: #fef2f2; color: #dc2626; padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: 6px; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.5; }

components.name: Loading Indicator
components.description: Inline loading state with descriptive text.
components.css: .ds-loading { background: #ffffff; padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: 6px; font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; color: #6b7280; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; } .ds-loading::before { content: ''; width: 14px; height: 14px; border: 2px solid #e5e7eb; border-top-color: #007943; border-radius: 50%; animation: ds-spin 0.6s linear infinite; } @keyframes ds-spin { to { transform: rotate(360deg); } }

components.name: Page Heading
components.description: Primary page heading. Appears once per page.
components.css: .ds-page-heading { font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: clamp(1.5rem, 4vw, 2rem); font-weight: 700; color: #1f2937; line-height: 1.2; margin: 0 0 24px 0; text-wrap: balance; }

narrative.overview: BorneMap's interfaces feel like a calm, reliable instrument — precise without being cold, present without being loud. The design steps back so the data leads. This system explicitly rejects the generic corporate dashboard aesthetic: overdesigned admin panels, dark-themed SaaS interiors, heavy cards-and-gradients. Instead, it is flat by default, using tonal layering rather than shadows to create hierarchy. Surfaces sit quietly; the information on them is what catches your eye.
keyCharacteristics: Flat, tonal hierarchy — no drop shadows at rest
Earthy green accent (Pine) used sparingly — it signals active state, never decoration
Refined and restrained components — clean lines, generous padding, gentle rounding (6-8px)
System font stack — no custom typefaces; clarity over personality
Calm colors, calm spacing, calm motion — nothing competes for attention

rules.name: The Quiet Accent Rule
rules.body: Pine (the primary green) is used on 10% or less of any given screen. Most of the interface is neutral. Color draws attention to the active thing and nothing else.

rules.name: The Status-Last Rule
rules.body: Semantic colors (error, success) always appear after the neutral information they qualify, never before. A station name and address come first; availability color follows.

rules.name: The One-Page Ceiling Rule
rules.body: Display type appears exactly once per page. It names the current surface. Everything below it uses Title or Body.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. No box-shadow on cards, panels, sidebars, or modals. Depth is communicated through tonal contrast, not simulated elevation.

dos: Do use Pine (#007943) as the single accent color. One green, one role: active state.
Do keep surfaces flat. Use tonal layering (border + background tint) for hierarchy, never box-shadow on cards or panels.
Do put information first, status second. Station name and address before charger count.
Do use the system font stack for all text. No imported web fonts - clarity and speed over typographic personality.
Do use gentle rounding: 6px for nav items and inputs, 8px for cards. Nothing more rounded than 8px.
Do space generously. 24px between cards, 16px internal padding as the default unit.
donts: Don't apply shadows to cards, panels, or sidebars. No shadow-sm, shadow-md, or any box-shadow on resting surfaces.
Don't use Pine as a decorative background. It is for interactive or active states only.
Don't use the green accent on more than 10% of any given screen. If the page looks green, the accent has lost its signal.
Don't build generic corporate dashboard patterns: no dark sidebars, no glowing gradients on stat cards, no icon-filled nav with tooltip labels, no border-left colored stripes on list items.
Don't use border-radius larger than 8px on any container, card, or section. Reserve pill shapes for badges only (and badges should be rare).
Don't use a spinner alone for loading. Always pair with a text description of what is loading.
Don't uppercase body text. Uppercase is for badges (max 4 words) only.
Don't nest cards. If a surface has multiple information groups, separate them with spacing and borders, not nested containers.
